name: Choking Tethers AP OLD
description: Three shadow tethers form when a creature reaches the hall's midpoint; each lashes, grabs, and crushes creatures in the hall.
disable: DC 48 Thievery (legendary) to disable each tether or Dispel Magic (10th rank, counteract DC 48) to counteract each tether
routine: (six actions) This trap loses 2 actions each turn for each disabled shadow tether. Each shadow tether has 2 actions it can use to either Strike a creature or Constrict a Grabbed creature, in any combination.

generalAbilities.name: Constrict
generalAbilities.description:
(4d10+22) Bludgeoning Damage, Basic DC 47 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

generalAbilities.name: Seize
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature reaches the hall's midpoint

Effect The trap attempts a shadow tether Strike against the triggering creature. On a hit, the triggering creature is automatically Grabbed. The trap then rolls initiative.
